definitions.gloss: crew member; crew; occupant of a vehicle
definitions.explanation: A person who operates or is on board a vehicle, aircraft, or vessel as part of its crew, or more broadly, any occupant of a vehicle.

examples.japanese: {乗員|じょういん}{全員|ぜんいん}が{無事|ぶじ}だった。
この{飛行機|ひこうき}の{乗員|じょういん}は{十二名|じゅうにめい}です。
examples.english: The crew of this aircraft consists of twelve people.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}で{車両|しゃりょう}の{乗員|じょういん}{三名|さんめい}が{病院|びょういん}に{搬送|はんそう}されたが、{命|いのち}に{別状|べつじょう}はない。
examples.english: Three occupants of the vehicle were taken to the hospital after the accident, but their lives are not in danger.

notes:
A compound of {乗|じょう} (to ride/board) and {員|いん} (member/personnel). Used in both professional contexts (crew of an aircraft, ship, or spacecraft) and in general reporting about vehicle occupants.

In news reports, {乗員|じょういん} often appears alongside {乗客|じょうきゃく} (passengers) in the set phrase {乗員|じょういん}{乗客|じょうきゃく} or {乗客|じょうきゃく}{乗員|じょういん}, covering everyone on board a vehicle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乗員|じょういん}{全員|ぜんいん}: all crew/occupants
- {乗員|じょういん}{乗客|じょうきゃく}: crew and passengers
- {乗員|じょういん}{数|すう}: number of crew/occupants
- {乗員|じょういん}を{救助|きゅうじょ}する: to rescue crew members

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {乗客|じょうきゃく}: passenger (those being transported, not operating the vehicle)
- {搭乗員|とうじょういん}: crew member (specifically for aircraft)
- {船員|せんいん}: ship crew member
